title: ICC-ES ESR-4524: Premier structural insulated panels (SIPs)
jurisdiction: United States (ICC-ES evaluation report under IBC/IRC); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
document_date: Reissued February 2025; subject to renewal February 2027 (p1)

facts.text: Report holder PREMIER BUILDING SYSTEMS, LLC; additional listees Big Sky Insulation, Inc. and Extreme Panel Technologies.

Premier SIPs are intended for load-bearing or non-load-bearing wall, roof, floor panels and headers; they are combustible for construction type under IBC Chapter 6 and may be used in fire-rated assemblies when installed per §4.2.11.
Installation must comply with the report and the approved construction documents; only the listed thicknesses apply; heights and spans may not be extrapolated.
Panels are produced in Puyallup, Washington; Belgrade, Montana; and Cottonwood, Minnesota under ICC-ES-inspected quality control.
Evidence listed: AC04 (June 2019, editorially revised December 2020); ASTM E119; ASTM E455; NFPA 286.
Each panel is labelled with the ESR number, a quality-assurance stamp, and a project or batch number.
